name: TRETINOIN (RETINOIC AC) .05 MG CREAM 30 GR 1 PIECE
description: Tretinoin, also known as retinoic acid, is a vitamin A derivative used to treat acne, fine wrinkles, and sun-induced hyperpigmentation. It accelerates skin cell turnover, improves collagen production, and reduces the adhesion of comedones. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
